Definition: Choreb, a (generic) name for the Sinaitic mountains
BiblicalUsage: Horeb is the mountain of God, the other name for Sinai, where Moses sees the burning bush and Elijah flees for his life. Moses turns aside at Horeb to see the bush that burns and is not consumed, the eleven days' journey from Horeb to Kadesh-barnea is measured from it, and Elijah walks forty days to Horeb and hears the still small voice there.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Horeb is holy ground because God meets men there, whether they come in wonder like Moses or in despair like Elijah. I hold that the God of the burning bush is the God of the still small voice, and He is the same in both.
RelatedEvents: The Burning Bush; Elijah at Horeb: The Still Small Voice
